## Mapping of Hospice Demand and Assets

- HSMA used their new mapping skills to map deprivation, referrals and hospice-related assets together

- Contributed to a successful business case


## Mapping of Violent Crime

- HSMAs used their skills to isolate hotspots of violent crime to target.
